analysis.one_line_summary: A young woman unwinds a pink Wavytalk thermal round brush from her bangs to reveal a bouncy, shiny blowout.
analysis.full_description: A young woman with layered dark hair sits in front of the camera with her front fringe wrapped around a pink Wavytalk thermal round brush. She rolls the heated brush out to reveal a smooth, bouncy curl, sets the brush on the table showing its digital display, and fluffs and styles her voluminous layers to the beat of background music while posing playfully.

scenes.visual: A young woman in a polka-dot dress seated indoors facing the camera, unwinding a pink Wavytalk thermal round brush from her bangs.
scenes.action: She carefully rolls the brush backward and lifts it out of her hair, creating a defined curl in her front bangs.

scenes.visual: Creator styling her bangs and setting down the styling tool.
scenes.action: She fluffs and parts her curtain bangs with her fingers and places the pink heated round brush onto the desk in front of her.

scenes.visual: Creator admiring and showing off her complete blowout hairstyle.
scenes.action: She touches her voluminous layers, adjusts her hair, makes playful facial expressions, and rests her chin on her hand while admiring the finished hair look.

hook.first_frame: Creator looking into the camera with her front hair wrapped around a pink Wavytalk thermal brush.
hook.visual_0_3s: Creator rolls the pink thermal brush out of her bangs, pulling it up and back to reveal a bouncy wave.
hook.pattern_interrupt: Immediate physical unwrapping and reveal of a perfectly curled bang from a heated brush.

narrative_beats: Curtain bang reveal and finger fluffing
Resting the product on the table
Flaunting the full bouncy voluminous blowout
key_claims: Achieve voluminous, bouncy 90s blowout hair at home with a thermal round brush

talent.hair_before: Pre-styled layered blowout with the front fringe section wrapped in a thermal brush
talent.hair_after: Voluminous, shiny, dark layered blowout with curled-under ends and curtain bangs

audio_and_edit.music_description: Mellow R&B pop song with female vocals singing 'hate that I made you love me'
audio_and_edit.ending: Creator rests her chin on her hand while posing with a slight pout to the camera

analysis.notes: Single continuous take phone UGC video demonstrating the final styling touch and aesthetic result of using a heated round brush.
